main.title: Profile
text: Recent software engineering graduate who builds games in Godot and Unity. I like gameplay programming, tools for designers and polishing game feel. Eager to join a small studio.

items.heading: Tiny Farm (itch.io, 5k downloads)
bullets: Cozy farming game made in Godot 4 with GDScript; save system and day/night cycle.
Ran a public playtest and iterated on feedback.

items.heading: Graduation project: VR Chemistry Lab
bullets: Unity + C# virtual lab for Meta Quest; interaction system with the XR Interaction Toolkit.

items.heading: Game Dev Intern — Sample Mobile Games (sample)
bullets: Implemented level editor tools in Unity for designers.
